about: Print runs (v0.5.1, api/print_runs.py, docs/shop.md "Print runs"): printings made in a known, small number of copies, which packs never deal more often than were printed. By Scryfall ID; copies is the serial's denominator. Every serialized printing Scryfall lists (is:serialized), each count from Wizards of the Coast's collecting articles or product pages, checked against the serial on the card's scan; in_boosters names the MTGJSON booster sheets that hold it.
